subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Whistleblower Protections
description: A fast breakdown of Whistleblower Protections for builders.

hook.text: An employee reports fraud. They get fired, blacklisted, and sued. This used to be normal.

buildup.text: Whistleblower retaliation was so severe that most employees who saw fraud stayed silent.

discovery.text: The Dodd-Frank Act created financial rewards — whistleblowers can receive 10-30% of SEC penalties.

twist.text: One SEC whistleblower received $279 million — the largest individual award in history.

climax.text: Since the program began, whistleblowers have helped the SEC recover over $6 billion.

punchline.text: Reporting fraud went from career suicide to a career move.

quiz.question: What is the largest SEC whistleblower award ever given?
